limitations: Browser tests use synthetic data only in isolated test harnesses; they do not demonstrate live deployment or mutate financial data.
Historical source fields or origin evidence that do not exist stay explicitly unknown; UI does not invent authorization dates, pensioner status or a score calibrated to credit risk.
Amounts/rates/retention/loan schedules/policy eligibility remain backend authority. Frontend only formats, filters and sums already supplied snapshot amounts in cents for visible-filter totals.
Final generated bundle and global local/GitHub regression evidence are owned by the parent integration task.
